senses.gloss: ch. same, color, v. אִכְרוּם.—כ׳ יַמָּא sea-green, name of a beryll (aqua marina).
units: Targ. Ex. XXVIII, 20; a. e.—*עִינְבֵי דִכְ׳ [green berries,] undeveloped grapes, worm-eaten grapes.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 106b">B. Mets. 106ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ דכדום</he> ed. a. Ar. (Ms. H. a. Rome 2, Alf. <he>דקרום</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50).
<cite ref="Nazir 34b">Naz. 34ᵇ</cite> (<cite ref="Nazir 38b">38ᵇ</cite>) <he>ע׳ דכרין</he> (Ar. <he>דכדום</he>, Rashi frequ. <he>ענבין דיכרין</he>), v. <cite ref="K01097"><he>כְּרַהּ</he></cite>.
